note: Text-table ranges whose records are names, labels and system messages rather than dialogue. Each locale's terms/<locale>.json translates every distinct original string of a section once; tools/content/apply_terms.py expands the tables into the locale's entries. Sections marked complete must translate every string that contains Japanese; the others list only what needs changing.
